text:
We checked “Harbour Club Fixed Folder” and found one issue in the InDesign file that is likely causing the problems in Frontify, plus 1 that may change how it looks. Here’s what to change:

Likely causing the problems

1. Adobe Font used
Adobe Fonts aren’t supported in Frontify templates (for licensing reasons), so the template falls back to another font.
Where: the font “Montserrat (OTF)”
• Install a desktop version of the font (OTF or TTF) that you’re licensed to use, and switch the text to it: Type > Find/Change Font, or update the paragraph and character styles.
• Package again with "Copy Fonts" checked, and zip the whole folder, including "Document fonts".
Learn more

May change how it looks

2. Hyphenation is on
Browsers hyphenate differently from InDesign, so lines may break in different places.
Where: paragraph styles “body arrangement wit”, “Arrangement”, “prijs” and 4 more, used on pages 1–2
• In the paragraph style, go to Hyphenation and uncheck Hyphenate.
Learn more

Once that’s done, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
